Chipotle is the easiest go to Paleo fast food. Meat, fajita veggies, guacamole, salsa (might have sugar), are all paleo and if you get enough it's pretty hearty.

I am not aware of any other fast food that is Paleo friendly. Fast food is often highly processed and includes many preservatives and additives that aren't healthy to consume. Your best bet if you wish to remain Paleo is to do a majority of your own cooking.
They all have salads available. I've found that going to the grocery store and buying a rotisserie chicken is a better option than fast food.
